subject: RightFit LangChain + Trace SDK harmonization — integration checklist and validation run
messages:
From: Alicia Stone <alicia.stone@rightfit.ai>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Devon Chu <devon.chu@rightfit.ai>, Thomas Kline <tkline@integral-consulting.com>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: RightFit -> Redwood: LangChain + Trace SDK integration exploration

Hi Jordan —

Great talking yesterday. As discussed, RightFit is evaluating a tighter integration between our orchestration layer and Redwood's hosted inference for customers using the LangChain SDK and Trace instrumentation. Two specific asks from our side:

- A short validation run to confirm the LangChain connector handles Redwood's streaming+trace headers with our existing middleware.
- A simple compatibility matrix for the versions/quantization profiles you recommend for latency-sensitive flows.

Devon and I put together a draft SOW and an initial compatibility spreadsheet attached. Can we coordinate a quick technical walk-through next week with an engineer from your runtime team?

Thanks — looking forward to the partnership.

Alicia Stone
Head of Platform Partnerships
RightFit Software

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Stone <alicia.stone@rightfit.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 01 Dec 2027 12:04:00 -0800
Subject: Re: RightFit -> Redwood: LangChain + Trace SDK integration exploration

Alicia —

Appreciate the materials and the quick sync earlier. Vanessa (partner lead) and Karthik (runtime engineer) are looped here. Quick notes and proposed next steps:

- We can run a 48-hour validation exercise against a dedicated sandbox tenant to exercise streaming + Trace SDK headers. Karthik, can you confirm availability next Tue/Wed (Dec 7/8)?
- I reviewed the SOW at a high level. We'd like to tighten the acceptance criteria section to include: 1) trace IDs preserved across redirects, 2) streaming chunk order preserved with our LRO headers, 3) example prompt set perf thresholds.
- Vanessa will align commercial terms and DocuSign flow once tech acceptance is clear.

Attaching the API compat matrix with our recommended runtime profiles filled in (for your team to review).

Jordan Blake
Sr. Partnerships Manager
Redwood Inference

Attachments: api-compat-matrix.xlsx

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Chu <devon.chu@rightfit.ai>, Alicia Stone <alicia.stone@rightfit.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 02 Dec 2027 10:33:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RightFit -> Redwood: LangChain + Trace SDK integration exploration

Hi Devon / Alicia —

Quick technical readout:

- We have a sandbox cluster that mirrors the streaming and KV-cache behavior for the hosted API. We can enable a tracing passthrough header: X-Redwood-Trace and echo it back in spans.
- For LangChain clients we typically recommend the openai-compatible adapter + our trace shim (v0.9.2) to preserve span context across async callbacks.
- From your matrix, I see you're targeting 2k token windows and int8 quantization on one of your profiles — that combination looks fine but expect ~12-20% variance vs fp16 in peak latency.

I'll stand by for a brief runbook session; I can pair with your engineers to run through a sample prompt set.

Karthik
Senior SW Eng, Runtime
Redwood Inference

From: Devon Chu <devon.chu@rightfit.ai>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alicia Stone <alicia.stone@rightfit.ai>, Thomas Kline <tkline@integral-consulting.com>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 08:05:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RightFit -> Redwood: LangChain + Trace SDK integration exploration

Thanks Karthik — this looks good. A couple clarifying points before the validation run:

1) Can the trace passthrough work when customers route requests through our orchestrator (headers added/removed mid-flight)? We need guarantees about unchanged trace IDs across redirects.
2) For the SOW acceptance test, can you help draft a 10-prompt canonical test set? Thomas from Integral Consulting will help craft realistic prompts for our enterprise customers.

We can do the pairing session on Wed Dec 8 at 10:00 PT if that works for your team.

—Devon
VP, Engineering
RightFit Software

From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>
To: Alicia Stone <alicia.stone@rightfit.ai>, Devon Chu <devon.chu@rightfit.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 06 Dec 2027 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RightFit -> Redwood: LangChain + Trace SDK integration exploration

Devon —

Yes on both counts: the trace passthrough preserves the trace id across our routing layer when the X-Redwood-Trace header is present; we'll include a short runbook step that ensures your orchestrator forwards the header unchanged. For the canonical prompts, Thomas and your team draft is perfect; Marissa (solutions) will convert them into the acceptance harness we run against the sandbox.

Confirmed: Wed Dec 8, 10:00 PT for the pairing session. I've attached an updated SOW with tightened acceptance criteria and a placeholder for the 10-prompt test set. Vanessa will follow up on commercial next steps after acceptance.

Jordan

Attachments: rightfit-sow-v1.pdf

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Devon Chu <devon.chu@rightfit.ai>, Alicia Stone <alicia.stone@rightfit.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 08 Dec 2027 15:45:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: RightFit -> Redwood: LangChain + Trace SDK integration exploration

Follow-up from today's pairing session — notes below (also saved to Drive: https://drive.redwood/example/rightfit-sow-v1):

- Validation run: sandbox tenant RF-SANDBOX-17 executed with the 10-prompt set. All prompts streamed successfully and traces were present in our collector with preserved IDs.
- Observations: int8 profile had a median token latency +18% vs fp16 in peak concurrency; streaming chunk order stable.
- Action items: 1) RightFit to confirm DocuSign redlines by Dec 15; 2) Redwood to publish a short runbook snippet for LangChain adapter config toggles (we'll push a PR to your repo with examples).

I've attached the validation-run-notes and the small compatibility matrix we updated post-run. If all good on your end, Vanessa will kick off the SOW signature and we can schedule the internal go-to-market brief.

Karthik
Senior SW Eng, Runtime
Redwood Inference

Attachments: validation-run-notes-20271208.txt, api-compat-matrix.xlsx
